items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Fred Marble, Henry Allen, Red Allen, Trumpet, you know. All the greats, you know.

ctx.x: I know she goes pretty good.

Yeah, how about that man? Big, son. And Coliseum was born. Then when they come down here, on with me. You know, if I was saying the wrong or the wrong thing, she wouldn't put it on the tape. Went to here, here. Wipe my hair, you know. I was making money in those days. At that time, see, I had the best seat in the house, man. I was in Monroe right there, man. I wasn't married or nothing, man. Plenty clothes, man. Plenty jeans, you know. That was my life, man. My best sweetheart in the world, my mama. God bless…
Suede, drumming. All my time was to go back to the drink gin.
